name: Marrowgate
worldBackground: Marrowgate is a market town of two streets: a square, a well, an inn with a gallery over the common room, and the weavers' rows where cloth is made and rented beds stack three storeys high. The Loops feed the town - wheat and kitchen gardens - and the carts come in on market days. The weavers' guild wants a charter; the innkeeper wants the guild's custom; neither says so out loud.

currency.name: Copper penny
currency.description: The small coin of Marrowgate's market; four make a silver bit.

narrativeRules: Count things: four looms, two carts, one well, a known number of rented beds.
The gallery is for watching the common room; everyone upstairs knows who comes in.
Guild business is discussed in the workshop, never in the inn.
The town wall is a ditch and a memory; nobody calls it a wall.

buildings.name: The Sickle & Sheaf

zones.name: The Loops

templates.name: Trestle table

templates.name: Long bench

templates.name: Clay hearth
templates.description: The clay hearth: every meal and all the warmth.
templates.physicalDescription: clay cooking hearth with iron pot and low fire
templates.rule: against a wall, away from the door

templates.name: Oak barrel
templates.description: An oak barrel: ale, salt, or nails.
templates.rule: in corners, or beside the hearth

templates.name: Iron-bound chest
templates.description: A chest for cloth, rent books or bedding.
templates.physicalDescription: low wooden chest with iron straps and lock plate

templates.name: Oil lamp
templates.description: A clay oil lamp, trimmed each dusk.
templates.physicalDescription: small clay oil lamp with steady flame
templates.rule: on a table or in the middle of a room that needs light

templates.name: Loom

templates.name: Spiral stair

templates.physicalDescription: narrow spiral staircase of wooden wedges seen from above

templates.name: Village well

templates.name: Oak tree

templates.name: Wheat row

templates.name: Scarecrow

templates.name: Herb bed

templates.physicalDescription: small garden bed of culinary herbs with stepping stones

rooms.name: Back Hall
rooms.purpose: the stair and the barrow of logs

rooms.name: Gallery

npcs.name: Sela Fox
npcs.description: The Sickle & Sheaf's keeper: counts every pint and every face on the gallery. Wants the weavers' guild to drink here after pay-day.
npcs.physicalDescription: Stout woman in her forties, apron, keys at the belt, ale-soiled towel over one shoulder

npcs.name: Maud Harness
npcs.description: Master of the workshop and keeper of the rent book: sharp with cloth and sharper with arrears. Wants a guild charter.
npcs.physicalDescription: Tall woman with yarn-threaded skirt, ink-stained fingers, measuring tape at the neck

npcs.name: Ned Sparrow
npcs.description: The apprentice: sleeps in the loom flat, hoards candle-ends, and knows which beds are let. Worries the charter talk will cost him his place.
npcs.physicalDescription: Gangly youth, cropped hair, weaver's thimbles on a cord round his neck

npcs.name: Hartley Green
npcs.description: The market gardener: herbs and early greens for the inn's kitchen. Wants a second strip in The Loops.
npcs.physicalDescription: Weathered old man, straw hat, basket of greens over one arm

player.name: Tam Pike
player.description: A chapman (pedlar) wintering at the Sickle & Sheaf: sells ribbon and news, listens more than he talks.
player.physicalDescription: Lean man with a patched coat, a pack of ribbons, and a smile that arrives before he does
